questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "bargain hunters" mean?
options: People who buy groceries on sale
Traders who sell at high prices
questions.explain_en: "Bargain hunters" refers to investors trying to buy stocks that have dropped in price, hoping for a good deal.
questions.explain_zh: 「bargain hunters」指的是想以較低價格買進股票、尋求好交易的投資人。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX plunges 4.8% as foreign funds flee, index heads for worst month since 2008

questions.question: How much did foreign institutions sell on the main board in net terms?
questions.explain_en: The summary states foreign institutions sold a net NT$123.65 billion on the main board.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說外資機構在主板淨賣出 123.65 億新台幣。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX plunges 4.8% as foreign funds flee, index heads for worst month since 2008

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "hammered" mean?
options: Caused a big drop in price
questions.explain_en: Here "hammered" means the stocks fell sharply because of the worries.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「hammered」指的是因擔憂而導致股價大幅下跌。
questions.news_title_en: AI-bubble fears sink TSMC and SK Hynix as the 'Huang boost' fades fast

questions.question: Which two companies led the regional declines after the rally faded?
questions.explain_en: The summary says TSMC and memory maker SK Hynix led the declines.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要指出台積電（TSMC）與記憶體製造商 SK Hynix 引領了區域跌勢。
questions.news_title_en: AI-bubble fears sink TSMC and SK Hynix as the 'Huang boost' fades fast

questions.question: In the text, what does the phrase "cross-disciplinary expertise" mean?
options: Ability to work only within the insurance industry
Knowledge in one specific field only
Skills that combine knowledge from several different fields
questions.explain_en: It refers to skills that draw from multiple different areas of knowledge, not just one specialty.
questions.explain_zh: 指的是結合多個不同領域知識的技能，而非單一專業。
questions.news_title_en: FSC widens the talent pool for insurer executives from 7 to 12 fields

questions.question: When will the new talent pool rules for insurer executives become effective?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the change is effective on Nov 22.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明此變更於 11 月 22 日生效。
questions.news_title_en: FSC widens the talent pool for insurer executives from 7 to 12 fields

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "discretionary" mean?
options: selected by a professional manager based on judgment
questions.explain_en: Here "discretionary" refers to mandates where a professional manager decides how to invest, using their judgment.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「discretionary」指的是由專業經理人自行判斷、決定投資方式的委託。

questions.question: What is the ticker symbol of the actively managed AI-technology Taiwan-equity ETF mentioned in the summary?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the ticker for that ETF is 00419A.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到該主動式 AI 科技台灣股票 ETF 的代號是 00419A。
questions.news_title_en: Active ETFs multiply as asset managers roll out new AI and equity strategies

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "exemption" mean?
options: a tax that must be paid
a reduction or removal of a tax requirement
questions.explain_en: An exemption is a reduction or removal of a tax requirement, as used for estate‑tax and gift‑tax exemptions.
questions.explain_zh: 「exemption」指的是減免稅負，文中是指遺產稅與贈與稅的免稅額。
questions.news_title_en: Estate- and gift-tax exemptions set to rise in 2027 as inflation crosses threshold

questions.question: According to the summary, by how much could heirs save in estate tax after the exemption increase?
questions.explain_en: The text states the change could save heirs over NT$150,000 in estate tax.
questions.explain_zh: 文中說，稅額調整後，繼承人可節省超過 15 萬新台幣的遺產稅。
questions.news_title_en: Estate- and gift-tax exemptions set to rise in 2027 as inflation crosses threshold

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "gauge" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "gauge" refers to a measurement tool, specifically the Fed's preferred inflation gauge measures inflation.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的 "gauge" 指的是測量工具，也就是美聯儲用來衡量通膨的指標。

questions.question: What was the annual rate of the core PCE in October?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that core PCE was 3.3% in October.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明核心個人消費支出（core PCE）在十月是 3.3%。
questions.news_title_en: US October PCE accelerates to 3.8%, a near three-year high
